test_title: PYST 12: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Amit: Where were you, Akash?

Akash: I didn't mean to leave you in the lurch. I thought we had canceled our meeting.

What does Akash mean by saying, "I didn't mean to leave you in the lurch"?

options.text: Akash didn't want to leave Amit in a difficult situation.
Akash was busy with some urgent work.
Akash forgot about the meeting completely.

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Akash didn't want to leave Amit in a difficult situation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"leave someone in the lurch"** means to abandon someone in a difficult or helpless situation without assistance. (किसी को कठिन परिस्थिति में अकेला छोड़ देना)

 
 
• **Example:** John promised to help me with the project, but he left me in the lurch at the last moment.
 
 

 
• Akash is expressing that he did not intend to leave Amit in a tough or tricky situation. (आकाश यह व्यक्त कर रहा है कि उसका इरादा अमित को कठिन परिस्थिति में अकेला छोड़ने का नहीं था।)

 
 
• **Example:** Akash clarified that he misunderstood the cancellation and did not intentionally leave Amit in the lurch.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 2:** Akash was busy with some urgent work. (आकाश किसी जरूरी काम में व्यस्त था।)
 
 
• **Example:** Akash couldn’t attend the meeting because he had some urgent work.
 

 
• **Option 3:** Akash forgot about the meeting completely. (आकाश पूरी तरह से बैठक को भूल गया।)
 
 
• **Example:** Akash apologized because he completely forgot about the meeting.
 

 
• **Option 4:** Akash was intentionally avoiding Amit. (आकाश जानबूझकर अमित से बच रहा था।)
 
 
• **Example:** Amit thought Akash was avoiding him, but that wasn’t the case.
